title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
内容提要
唐僧在西行取经的路上，行至宝林寺，夜梦被妖魔杀害的乌鸡国王，求他师徒帮助捉妖复仇。悟空、八戒到御花园，从井中取出国王尸体，向太上老君求来“还魂丹”，救活国王，一同前去降妖。不料那妖魔神通广大，变为师父唐僧模样。悟空见两个师父并站阶前，不易分辨捉打，后八戒想计认出假唐僧，降服了魔鬼青毛狮子王。

1 却说唐僧西行取经的路上，有个乌鸡国。这年，国里发生旱灾，河干井枯，五谷不收，眼看百姓都要饿死。国王焦急万分，便召集百官商议，可谁也想不出好办法。
page_text_en:
Content Summary
On his journey to the West to obtain scriptures, Tang Sanzang arrives at Baolin Temple and dreams of the murdered King of Wujing, who asks his disciples to help capture the demon and avenge him. Wukong and Bajie go to the imperial garden, retrieve the king's body from a well, obtain the "Soul-Returning Pill" from the Lord Laojun, revive the king, and set off together to subdue the demon. Unbeknownst to them, the demon is powerful and transforms into the likeness of Master Tang Sanzang. Wukong sees two masters standing side by side on the steps and finds it hard to distinguish between them, making it difficult to attack. Later, Bajie devises a plan to identify the fake Tang Sanzang and subdues the demon, the Green-Haired Lion King.

1 Once upon a time, as Tang Sanzang traveled westward to obtain scriptures, he came to the Kingdom of Wujing. That year, the country suffered a drought: rivers dried up, wells ran dry, crops failed, and the people were on the brink of starvation. The king was extremely anxious and summoned his ministers to discuss solutions, but no one could come up with a good plan.
summary_zh: 本页包含《真假唐僧》的故事提要和第一幅插图及文字。提要概述了唐僧师徒在乌鸡国降妖的经过，正文第一段则交代了乌鸡国遭遇旱灾、百姓饥荒、国王忧心忡忡的背景。

2 正在此时，锺南山来了一个道人，拜见国王，自称能呼风唤雨。国王闻听大喜，立刻请他登坛祈祷求雨。
3 那道人果然神通广大，只见他念念有词，令牌一响，立刻天气骤变，大雨如注。雨水足足下了三尺，枯死的庄稼，全都重活过来。
page_text_en:
2 At this moment, a Taoist from Zhongnan Mountain came to pay respects to the king, claiming he could summon wind and rain. The king was overjoyed and immediately invited him to ascend the altar to pray for rain.
3 The Taoist indeed possessed great supernatural powers. As he chanted incantations and struck his command tablet, the weather suddenly changed, and heavy rain poured down. The rain fell three feet deep, and all the withered crops came back to life.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了乌鸡国国王在旱灾期间，迎请一位自称能呼风唤雨的道人祈雨，道人施法后大雨倾盆，枯死的庄稼得以复苏。

4 国王心里着实感激，就和道人结拜为兄弟，把他留在宫中。一天，春光明媚，国王与道人携手缓步，来到御花园观花赏景。
5 两人行到琉璃井边，那道人不知将什么物件扔到井中，井里立刻射出万道金光。道人哄国王说井中有宝。国王受骗，刚俯首要看，被道人推到井内。
page_text_en:
4 The king was truly grateful and became sworn brothers with the Taoist, keeping him in the palace. One day, with spring sunshine bright, the king and the Taoist walked hand in hand to the imperial garden to admire the flowers and scenery.
5 As they walked to the edge of the Crystal Well, the Taoist threw some unknown object into the well, and instantly, the well shot out countless beams of golden light. The Taoist tricked the king into believing there was treasure in the well. The king, deceived, bent down to look, and was pushed into the well by the Taoist.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了乌鸡国国王因道人祈雨有功而与之结拜，并在御花园散步时，被道人骗至琉璃井边，最终推入井中的情节。

6 道人立即用石板盖住井口，堆上泥土，移一株芭蕉栽在上面，看看已无破绽，摇身一变，变做国王模样，返身入宫。
7 那妖道夺得皇位，每日上朝登殿，满朝文武百官、皇后、太子，谁也没有察觉。只苦了那个落井的国王，他的冤魂，东飘西荡，没处伸冤。
page_text_en:
6 The Taoist immediately covered the well mouth with a stone slab, piled soil on top, moved a banana tree to plant over it, checked that there were no traces, transformed himself, turned into the king's appearance, and returned to the palace.
7 The demonic Taoist seized the throne, attended court daily, and the entire court of civil and military officials, the queen, and the crown prince, none of them noticed. Only the king who fell into the well suffered; his wronged spirit wandered aimlessly, unable to seek justice.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了妖道将国王推入井中后，用石板和泥土掩盖井口，并变作国王模样返回皇宫；随后妖道篡位，每日上朝，而真正的国王冤魂无处伸冤。

8 再说唐僧师徒一行，降了莲花洞妖怪，继续前行。这一天，路过宝林寺，唐僧见天色已晚，便下得马来，带领徒弟进寺借宿。
9 寺里和尚听说是东土大唐来的圣僧，十分恭敬。吃罢晚斋，打扫禅堂，请唐僧师徒安歇。唐僧连声道谢。
page_text_en:
8 After subduing the monster of Lotus Cave, Tang Sanzang and his disciples continued their journey. One day, passing by Baolin Temple, Tang Sanzang saw that it was already evening, so he dismounted and led his disciples into the temple to stay for the night.
9 The monks in the temple, hearing that they were holy monks from the Eastern Tang Dynasty, treated them with great respect. After dinner, they cleaned the meditation hall and invited Tang Sanzang and his disciples to rest. Tang Sanzang kept thanking them.
summary_zh: 唐僧师徒降服莲花洞妖怪后继续西行，傍晚路过宝林寺，因天色已晚便入寺借宿，寺中和尚恭敬接待，安排他们安歇。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang

10 悟空、八戒、沙僧因路上劳累，倒头睡下。唐僧关好房门，拨亮灯光，摊开经卷，端坐着念起经来。
11 唐僧坐到三更时分，有些困倦，便伏在经案上盹睡。忽听有人叫了一声“师父！”紧接着进来一个汉子，浑身上下，水淋淋的。
page_text_en:
10 Wukong, Bajie, and Sha僧 were tired from the journey and fell asleep. Tang僧 closed the door, lit the lamp, opened the scripture, and sat upright to recite it.
11 Tang僧 sat until the third watch, feeling a bit tired, and dozed off on the scripture table. Suddenly, he heard someone call out, "Master!" Then a man came in,浑身 wet from head to toe.
summary_zh: 唐僧在宝林寺借宿，因徒弟们劳累睡去，他独自点灯念经；至三更时分，他伏案小憩，忽闻呼喊，一个浑身湿透的汉子闯入房中。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf

12 唐僧一怔，欠身道：‘你是什么妖魔鬼怪，深夜前来打扰我？’那人道：‘师父！我不是妖魔鬼怪。可怜我啊，落井丧命，王位被夺，这般冤屈，说来真是伤心！’
13 原来这汉子，正是那被害国王的冤魂。他将被害经过细细叙了一遍，说：‘久闻圣僧徒弟道行高深，万望捉拿妖魔，报仇雪恨。’说罢，拜倒在地，苦苦哀求。
page_text_en:
12 Tang Sanzang was startled and leaned forward, saying, 'What kind of demon or ghost are you, coming to disturb me at this late hour?' The man replied, 'Master! I am not a demon or ghost. Poor me, I fell into a well and lost my life, my throne was stolen. Such injustice is truly heartbreaking!'
13 It turned out this man was the vengeful spirit of the murdered king. He recounted his tragic story in detail, saying, 'I've heard your disciples are highly skilled in martial arts. I beg you to capture the demon and avenge my death.' After speaking, he fell to the ground, pleading desperately.
summary_zh: 唐僧在宝林寺借宿时，被一位浑身湿透的汉子惊醒。该男子自称是乌鸡国被害国王的冤魂，向唐僧诉说被妖道推入井中、王位被夺的冤屈，并恳求唐僧师徒捉拿妖魔、报仇雪恨。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf

14 唐僧忙把他搀起，说：‘这倒不难，我的三个徒弟，都是降妖捉怪的英豪。只是贵国在何处？如何寻到那妖道？还得陛下指点。’
15 那人道：‘乌鸡国就在正西，离此四十里，宫内有我太子，明天出城打猎。这是一件白玉珪，可做标记，师父拿去，把我的遭遇说与太子，他见此物，便信了。望圣僧开恩替我报仇。’唐僧点头答应了。
page_text_en:
14 Tang Sanzang hurriedly helped him up and said, 'This is not difficult. My three disciples are all heroes who subdue demons and capture monsters. But where is your country? How can we find that demon? I still need Your Majesty to give me some guidance.'
15 The man said, 'The kingdom of Wujing is to the west, forty li away. My prince is inside the palace and will go hunting tomorrow. This is a white jade tablet, which can serve as proof. Master, take it and tell my story to the prince. When he sees this object, he will believe you. I beg you, Master, to avenge me.' Tang Sanzang nodded in agreement.
summary_zh: 唐僧在宝林寺借宿时，被乌鸡国被害国王的冤魂惊醒。冤魂向唐僧诉说遭遇，并告知乌鸡国位置及太子行踪，留下白玉珪作为信物，请求唐僧师徒替他报仇。唐僧答应相助。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
16 那人叩谢拜别，唐僧起身相送，不料脚下一滑，跌了个跟斗。唐僧“啊呀”一声，睁眼看时，却原来是南柯一梦。
17 唐僧十分惊讶，叫醒徒弟，把方才的怪梦告诉他们。徒弟们半信半疑，把灯拨亮，却见桌上真的留下一件白玉珪。悟空说：“既有此物，梦里的事一定是真的，明日拿妖，包在老孙身上。”
page_text_en:
16 The man bowed and took his leave. Tang Sanzang rose to see him off, but slipped and fell. Tang Sanzang cried out, "Ah!" and opened his eyes to find it had all been a dream.
17 Tang Sanzang was greatly startled and woke his disciples, telling them about the strange dream. The disciples were half-believing, half-doubting, and brightened the lamp. To their surprise, a white jade tablet was indeed left on the table. Wukong said, "Since we have this object, the events in the dream must be true. Tomorrow, catching the demon is guaranteed to be my job!"
summary_zh: 唐僧从与冤魂相见的梦中惊醒，发现桌上留有白玉珪，悟空认定梦中之事为真，决心次日捉拿妖魔。

title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang

18 次日，东方发白，行者纵身，跳在空中，果见西边一座城池，甚是雄伟。不多时，东门大开，涌出一队人马，为首的一员小将，十分威武。悟空心想：太子当真打猎来了，等我戏他一戏。
19 悟空按落云头，摇身一变，变作一只白兔，在太子马前跑来跑去。
page_text_en:
18 The next day, as the east turned white, the Monkey King leaped into the air and saw a magnificent city to the west. Soon after, the eastern gate opened, and a troop of men and horses emerged, led by a valiant young general. Wukong thought: The prince has truly come hunting; I'll play a trick on him.
19 Wukong landed from the clouds, transformed himself into a white rabbit, and ran back and forth before the prince's horse.
summary_zh: 孙悟空腾云驾雾来到乌鸡国，发现太子正在城外打猎，便化作白兔在太子马前奔跑，准备戏弄他。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf

20 太子看见白兔，满心欢喜，搭箭拉弓，“嗖”的一箭射中白兔。白兔带着箭，向前猛跑。太子策马紧紧追赶。
21 悟空把太子引到宝林寺山门，现出本象，兔子不见了。只有那枝箭插在门槛上。
page_text_en:
20 The prince saw a white rabbit, delighted, drew his bow and arrow, and shot it with a 'whoosh'. The rabbit, carrying the arrow, ran forward fiercely. The prince urged his horse to chase closely.
21 Wukong led the prince to the gate of Baolin Temple, revealed his true form, and the rabbit disappeared. Only the arrow remained stuck in the threshold.
summary_zh: 孙悟空化作白兔引诱乌鸡国太子射箭，随后现出真身，将太子引至宝林寺山门，箭插在门槛上。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf

22 太子大惊失色道：‘怪哉！怪哉！分明我射中了白兔，怎么箭在这里？’抬头一看，见山门上有五个大字：‘敕建宝林寺’。太子跳下马来，取下那枝箭，心想：我何不进去走走。
23 保驾的兵将簇拥着太子走进寺内，寺里僧众，都来叩头迎接。太子直入正殿，参拜佛像。
page_text_en:
22 The prince was greatly startled and exclaimed, 'Strange! Strange! I clearly shot the white rabbit, so how come the arrow is here?' Looking up, he saw five large characters on the mountain gate: 'Chu Jian Bao Lin Temple'. The prince dismounted, took the arrow, and thought to himself: 'Why not go in and take a look?
23 The guards and soldiers escorted the prince into the temple. The monks inside all came forward to bow and welcome him. The prince entered the main hall and paid his respects to the Buddha statue.
summary_zh: 乌鸡国太子在打猎时射箭后发现箭插在宝林寺山门，便进入寺内，受到僧众迎接并参拜佛像。

source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf

24 正要下拜，忽见正中端坐着一个和尚。太子大怒道：
“这和尚无礼，怎么见了我坐着不动？”他喝令校尉把唐僧
捆起来。
25 这时悟空躲在暗处，忙念咒语，将师父护住。那些
校尉只是在唐僧周围乱蹦乱跳，好像有一堵墙壁挡住一样，
不能近前。
page_text_en:
24 Just as he was about to bow, he suddenly saw a monk sitting calmly in the center. The prince became furious and said:
"This monk is impolite! How can he sit still when he sees me?" He ordered the guards to bind Master Tang.
25 At that moment, Wukong, hiding in the shadows, quickly chanted a spell to protect his master. The guards jumped and scrambled around Master Tang, as if blocked by a wall, unable to get close.
summary_zh: 乌鸡国太子进寺参拜时，见唐僧端坐不动，大怒命人将其捆缚；孙悟空暗中念咒，以法力护住师父，使校尉无法靠近。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
26 太子大怒道：‘你这和尚是那方来的，敢使隐身法欺我！’唐僧施礼道：‘贫僧乃是东土唐僧，上雷音寺拜佛求经。’
27 太子道：‘你那东土虽是中原，其穷无比，有甚么宝贝，你说来我听。’唐僧暗想是时候了，便将白玉珪双手捧上，献与太子，说道：‘殿下请看，这等宝贝，奇也不奇？’
page_text_en:
26 The prince angrily said: 'You monk, where are you from? How dare you use invisibility to deceive me!' Tang Sanzang bowed and said: 'I am a monk from the Eastern Land, traveling to the Western Paradise to worship Buddha and seek the scriptures.'
27 The prince said: 'Your Eastern Land, though in the Central Plains, is extremely poor. What treasures do you have? Tell me.' Tang Sanzang thought it was time, so he took the white jade tablet, held it with both hands, presented it to the prince, and said: 'Your Highness, please look at this treasure. Is it wonderful or not?'
summary_zh: 乌鸡国太子质问唐僧来历，唐僧自称东土取经僧人。太子讥讽东土贫瘠，唐僧便将白玉珪献上，试探太子反应。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
28 这白玉珪，是乌鸡国的国宝，太子怎会不认得，忙问唐僧从何处得来。唐僧把国王托梦的事说了一遍，那太子一听，禁不住掉下泪来。
29 唐僧安慰太子，说：‘你先回去，明天我就叫徒弟们来替你捉妖。只是一件，在那妖道面前，切莫走漏消息。’太子叩头拜别，率领随从回城去了。
page_text_en:
28 This white jade tablet is the national treasure of Wujing Kingdom. How could the prince not recognize it? He hurriedly asked Master Tang where he had obtained it. Master Tang recounted the story of the king's dream. Upon hearing this, the prince couldn't help but shed tears.
29 Master Tang comforted the prince, saying: 'Go back first. Tomorrow, I will send my disciples to capture the demon for you. But remember one thing: do not reveal this to the demon.' The prince bowed his head in farewell and led his followers back to the city.
summary_zh: 唐僧向乌鸡国太子展示白玉珪并讲述国王托梦之事，太子听后落泪。唐僧承诺次日派徒弟捉妖，并叮嘱太子保密，太子拜别后率众回城。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
30 当晚，师徒们早早睡下。悟空心中有事睡不着，一骨碌爬起来，来到八戒床前，轻声叫：‘八戒！八戒！’那呆子白天辛苦，倒下就呼呼大睡，哪里叫得醒。
31 悟空揪着耳朵，把八戒拉起来。八戒道：‘睡了吧！别闹，明天还要去捉妖怪哩！’悟空道：‘兄弟，不是闹，有一桩好买卖，我和你做去。’八戒听说有买卖，翻身起来。
page_text_en:
30 That night, the master and disciples went to sleep early. Wukong, unable to sleep due to his thoughts, got up and went to Bajie's bed, calling softly: 'Bajie! Bajie!' That clumsy fellow, tired from the day's work, had fallen into a deep sleep as soon as he lay down, and couldn't be woken up.
31 Wukong grabbed Bajie by the ears and pulled him up. Bajie said: 'Go back to sleep! Don't make a fuss, we still have to catch the demon tomorrow!' Wukong replied: 'Brother, I'm not making a fuss. There's a good deal to be had, and I want to do it with you.' Upon hearing there was a deal, Bajie turned over and got up.
summary_zh: 当晚，孙悟空因心事睡不着，去叫猪八戒，但八戒睡得香甜叫不醒。孙悟空只好揪着八戒的耳朵将他拉起，谎称有好买卖，八戒一听便起身。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
32 悟空道：‘太子告诉我，那妖精有件法宝，着实厉害。为了明天不吃亏，不如先下手，我和你去偷了来。’八戒先是不肯，后来悟空答应盗来法宝归他所有，那呆子才答应同去。
33 八戒取了钉钯和悟空悄悄离开宝林寺，纵身跳到空中，直奔乌鸡国京城。
page_text_en:
32 Wukong said, 'The prince told me that the demon has a powerful treasure. To avoid being at a disadvantage tomorrow, let's strike first and steal it together.' At first, Bajie refused, but after Wukong promised to give the treasure to him, the foolish one finally agreed to go.
33 Bajie took his rake and, with Wukong, quietly left Baolin Temple, leaped into the air, and headed straight for the capital of Wujing Kingdom.
summary_zh: 孙悟空劝说猪八戒一同去偷妖精的法宝，八戒起初不肯，后被许诺法宝归他所有才答应。两人随后离开宝林寺，腾云驾雾直奔乌鸡国京城。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
34 来到京城，两人跳进围墙跃入皇宫。正走时，忽见一座高大的门楼，上有三个亮灼灼的金字：“御花园”。悟空近前一看，门紧锁着，上面还有几道封条。
35 悟空命八戒动手打门，那呆子抡起铁钯，用力一筑，把门筑了个粉碎。然后两人迈步跨进御花园。
page_text_en:
34 They arrived in the capital city, jumped over the wall, and entered the imperial palace. As they walked, they suddenly saw a tall gatehouse with three shining golden characters: 'Imperial Garden'. Wukong approached and saw the gate was locked, with several seals on it.
35 Wukong ordered BaJie to break the gate. That clumsy fellow raised his iron rake, struck it hard, and smashed the gate to pieces. Then the two stepped into the Imperial Garden.
summary_zh: 孙悟空和猪八戒潜入乌鸡国皇宫，发现御花园大门紧锁，悟空命八戒用铁钯砸开门锁，两人进入御花园。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
36 来到一株芭蕉跟前，悟空道：‘八戒，动手吧！宝贝在芭蕉树下埋着哩。’那呆子双手举钯，刨倒了芭蕉，再往下筑，见有石板盖住，揭开石板看时，却是一口古井。
37 八戒想下井取宝贝，只是没绳索。悟空把金箍棒拿出来，两头一扯，叫声‘长’！顿时变成七八丈长。悟空笑道：‘八戒，你抱着一头儿，我把你放下去。’
page_text_en:
36 They arrived at a banana tree. Wukong said, 'BaJie, let's get to work! The treasure is buried under the banana tree.' The dullard raised his rake, chopped down the banana tree, and dug further down. He found a stone slab covering the ground. When they lifted the slab, they saw an ancient well.
37 BaJie wanted to go down the well to get the treasure, but there was no rope. Wukong took out his Golden-Hooped Rod, pulled it at both ends, and shouted, 'Grow!' Instantly, it became seven or eight zhang long. Wukong laughed and said, 'BaJie, hold onto one end, and I'll lower you down.'
summary_zh: 孙悟空和猪八戒在芭蕉树下挖出一口古井，悟空用金箍棒变长后，准备让八戒抱着棒子下井取宝贝。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
38 八戒贪得宝贝，当真抱住铁棒，被悟空放下去。八戒挨近水面时，悟空将棒往下一按，那呆子扑通掉进水里。悟空叫道：‘宝贝在水底下哩，你下去摸一摸吧。’
39 八戒水性极好，用劲往下一钻，到了井底。他双手乱摸，一把摸着那国王的尸首。慌得他脚软筋麻，蹿出水面，嚷道：‘师兄！伸下棒来救我一救！’
page_text_en:
38 Pigsy, greedy for the treasure, truly clutched the iron staff and was lowered down by Wukong. As Pigsy neared the water surface, Wukong pressed the staff down, and the fool plunged into the water with a splash. Wukong called out: 'The treasure is at the bottom of the water, go down and feel for it.'
39 Pigsy, being very good at swimming, dived down with force and reached the bottom of the well. He frantically groped with his hands and suddenly touched the corpse of the king. Terrified, his legs turned to jelly and he leapt out of the water, shouting: 'Brother! Extend the staff to save me!'
summary_zh: 孙悟空将猪八戒放入井中寻宝，猪八戒在井底摸到国王尸首，惊恐万分，急忙呼救。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
40 悟空道：‘可有宝贝么？’八戒道：‘哪里有！只摸着一具尸首。’悟空说那尸首就是宝贝，要八戒驮上来。那呆子明知上了当，也只好把那尸首抱起，叫悟空赶快放下棒来。
41 上得井来，八戒将尸首放下。那国王虽死了多时，却容颜如生。悟空怕师父惦记，叫八戒驮上尸首，两人纵入云头，奔回宝林寺。
page_text_en:
40 Wukong asked, 'Is there any treasure?' Bajie replied, 'Where? I only touched a corpse.' Wukong said the corpse was the treasure and told Bajie to carry it up. The fool, knowing he had been tricked, could only pick up the corpse and told Wukong to quickly lower the staff.
41 After climbing out of the well, Bajie put the corpse down. Though the king had been dead for a long time, his face still looked lifelike. Wukong, fearing the master would worry, told Bajie to carry the corpse, and the two soared into the clouds, rushing back to Baolin Temple.
summary_zh: 孙悟空和猪八戒在井底发现国王尸首，悟空谎称尸首是宝贝，骗八戒将其抱出井；随后两人带着尸首腾云驾雾返回宝林寺。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
42 唐僧见到尸体，十分悲痛地说：‘悟空，救人一命，胜造七级浮屠，你快去兜率宫太上老君那里把他的‘九转还魂丹’求一粒来，也好救活国王。’悟空答应，转身去了。
43 好悟空，纵祥云，直奔南天门。进入兜率宫，只见太上老君坐在那里，看众仙童搧火炼丹。悟空说明来意，老君倒也爽快，即命仙童取来一粒‘还魂金丹’给了悟空。
page_text_en:
42 Tang Sanzang saw the corpse and said sorrowfully, 'Wukong, saving one life is better than building seven-tiered pagodas. Quickly go to the Palace of Dousheng and ask the Lord Laojun for a single pill of the 'Nine-Transformations Soul-Returning Pill' to revive the king.' Wukong agreed and turned to leave.
43 Good Wukong, riding the auspicious cloud, rushed straight to the Southern Heavenly Gate. Entering the Palace of Dousheng, he saw Lord Laojun sitting there, watching the celestial children fan the fire to refine pills. Wukong explained his purpose, and the Lord, being quite generous, immediately ordered a celestial child to bring a 'Soul-Returning Golden Pill' to Wukong.
summary_zh: 唐僧见到国王尸首后悲痛不已，命孙悟空去兜率宫向太上老君求取‘九转还魂丹’；孙悟空随即驾云前往，太上老君爽快地赐予他一粒‘还魂金丹’。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
44 悟空回来，叫八戒、沙僧帮他掰开死尸牙齿，用一口清水，把金丹灌下肚。有半个时辰，只听那国王肚里呼呼乱响，渐渐手脚动弹，睁开眼来。
45 不多时，国王爬起身来，叫了唐僧一声“师父”！忙又双膝跪下，叩谢救命之恩。唐僧搀起他道：“陛下，不必谢我，你去谢我徒弟吧！”悟空笑道：“师父说哪里话？常言道：‘家无二主。’你就受他一拜吧！”
page_text_en:
44 Wukong returned, called for Bajie and Sha僧 to help him pry open the corpse's teeth, used a mouthful of clear water to administer the golden pill into his stomach. After half a time period, they heard the king's stomach rumble, and gradually his limbs began to move, and he opened his eyes.
45 Soon after, the king got up, called out to Tang僧, "Master!" and hurriedly knelt down with both knees, thanking him for saving his life. Tang僧 lifted him up and said, "Your Majesty, you need not thank me. Go thank my disciples instead!" Wukong laughed, "Master, what are you saying? As the saying goes, 'A household cannot have two masters.' Just accept one bow from him!"
summary_zh: 孙悟空用太上老君赐予的还魂金丹救活了乌鸡国国王，国王苏醒后向唐僧叩谢救命之恩，唐僧让国王感谢徒弟，孙悟空则幽默地表示应接受国王一拜。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
46 第二天清早，众人商量妥当，国王扮做和尚模样，跟着唐僧师徒，一行五人，回乌鸡国捉妖道去了。
47 且说，这天假国王刚上朝，皇门官启奏道：‘宫外有五个僧人，说是东土唐国钦差上西天拜佛求经，现来倒换关文，听候传见。’那魔王即令传见。
page_text_en:
46 The next morning, after everyone had discussed and agreed, the king disguised himself as a monk, followed the Tang Monk and his disciples, and the five of them set off back to Wujing Kingdom to capture the demon.
47 Meanwhile, that day, the false king had just ascended the throne, and the palace gate officer reported: 'There are five monks outside the palace, claiming to be imperial envoys from the Eastern Tang Kingdom sent to the Western Heaven to worship Buddha and seek scriptures. They have come to exchange their passes and are waiting to be received.' The demon king immediately ordered them to be brought in.
summary_zh: 国王扮作和尚，与唐僧师徒一行五人返回乌鸡国捉妖；与此同时，假国王在朝堂上接到报告，称有五个僧人前来倒换关文，便下令传见。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
48 唐僧师徒领着国王上了金銮殿，太子眼快，早见父王走在中间，不觉又惊又喜。正想过去拜见父王，悟空眼尖，给他使了个眼色，意思是要他再忍耐一时。
49 那魔王见五个僧人站在白玉阶前面，既不开口，又不跪下，便大声喝道：‘你们这些和尚，好大胆无礼，见了寡人怎敢不拜！’
page_text_en:
48 The Tang Monk and his disciples led the king to the Golden Hall. The crown prince, quick-eyed, saw his father walking in the center and was both surprised and delighted. Just as he was about to go forward to greet his father, Wukong, sharp-eyed, gave him a glance, signaling him to wait a little longer.
49 The demon king saw five monks standing before the white jade steps, neither speaking nor kneeling, and shouted loudly: 'You monks, how dare you be so bold and disrespectful? How can you fail to bow to me!'
summary_zh: 唐僧师徒带着复活的乌鸡国国王进入金銮殿，太子认出父亲，欲上前相认，孙悟空示意他暂忍；假国王（魔王）见五僧不跪，怒斥其无礼。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
50 悟空笑道：‘是真国王便拜，是假国王俺却不拜。’那魔王心里有病，听这话，猛吃一惊！瞪睛一看，见被他害死的国王居然也站在面前。
51 那魔王慌了手脚，抽身要走，手里却没兵器，猛回头，只见镇殿将军腰挂一口宝刀，便夺了宝刀，纵身望空而逃。
page_text_en:
50 Wukong laughed: 'I'll bow to the real king, but not to the fake one.' The demon king, who had a guilty conscience, was suddenly shocked by these words! He looked up and saw the king he had killed standing right before him.
51 The demon king panicked, tried to flee, but had no weapon. He turned back and saw a guard officer with a precious sword at his waist. He snatched the sword and leaped into the sky to escape.
summary_zh: 孙悟空在金銮殿上当众揭穿假国王，假国王惊慌失措，夺刀逃走。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
52 好悟空，吩咐八戒、沙僧，好好保护国王父子和师父，又与唐僧说了声：‘我去了！’纵身一跃，就不见踪影了。
53 悟空跳在九霄云里，四下眺望，只见那魔王正往东北方逃走。悟空赶得将近，喝道：‘怪物，哪里去，老孙来了！’
page_text_en:
52 Good Wukong, he instructed Bajie and Sha僧 to protect the king, his son, and the master well, then said to Tang僧, 'I'm off!' He leapt into the air and vanished.
53 Wukong jumped into the clouds, looked around, and saw the demon king fleeing northeast. As he drew near, he shouted, 'Monster, where are you going? Here comes Old Sun!'
summary_zh: 孙悟空吩咐八戒和沙僧保护国王父子及师父后，腾云而去追赶逃走的魔王；他在云中发现魔王往东北方逃跑，便高声喝斥追击。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
54 那妖怪急回身，拔出宝刀，高叫道：‘泼猴，你好无理，我来占别人的王位，与你无干，你怎么来抱不平！’悟空二话不说，抡起铁棒，劈头打了过去。
55 那魔王闪身躲过，抡起宝刀劈面相迎。战不数合，那魔王抵不住猴王，虚晃一刀，又朝原路逃回城中。
page_text_en:
54 The demon quickly turned around, drew his precious sword, and shouted: 'You rascal, how dare you be so unreasonable? I came to take over someone else's throne, which has nothing to do with you. Why are you coming to interfere?' Without saying a word, Wukong raised his iron staff and swung it down at the demon's head.
55 The demon king dodged, raised his sword to meet the attack head-on. After only a few exchanges, the demon king couldn't withstand the Monkey King, feinted with a slash, and fled back to the city along the same path.
summary_zh: 孙悟空在云中追击逃走的魔王，魔王拔刀迎战并辱骂悟空多管闲事，悟空随即挥棒反击；魔王不敌，虚晃一刀后逃回城中。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
56 悟空紧紧追赶。那魔王闯入白玉阶前人丛里，摇身一变，变得与唐僧一般模样。真假唐僧，并排立在阶前。
57 悟空赶到，举棒便打，那魔王急道：“徒弟莫打，是我！”待要打那个唐僧，那唐僧却也道：“徒弟莫打，是我！”八戒、沙僧等人也都看得呆了。
page_text_en:
56 Wukong chased closely. The demon king rushed into the crowd before the white jade steps, transformed himself with a shake, and became exactly like Tang Sanzang. The real and fake Tang Sanzang stood side by side before the steps.
57 Wukong arrived, raised his staff to strike, and the demon king cried out in panic: "Disciple, don't hit! It's me!" Just as he was about to strike the other Tang Sanzang, that Tang Sanzang also cried out: "Disciple, don't hit! It's me!" Pigsy, Sandy, and others were all stunned.
summary_zh: 孙悟空追击魔王至宫殿前，魔王化身为唐僧模样，与真唐僧并立；悟空举棒欲打，真假唐僧同时喊出“是我”，令八戒、沙僧等人惊呆。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
58 悟空忙问八戒、沙僧：‘你们快说，哪一个是妖怪？哪一个是师父？’八戒道：‘我正看你在半空打那厮，一眨眼就见两个师父，也不知谁真谁假。’
59 悟空搔头挖耳，没了主意。突然，八戒呵呵笑道：‘哥啊，说我呆，你比我还呆哩！这有何难，师父会念紧箍咒，那怪不会，你叫他两个念一念，不就辨出来了？’
page_text_en:
58 Wukong hurriedly asked Bajie and Sha Wujing: 'Quick, tell me, which one is the demon? Which one is the Master?' Bajie replied: 'I was just watching you fight that fellow in mid-air, and in a blink, I saw two Masters. I don't know which is real and which is fake.'
59 Wukong scratched his head and ears, at a loss. Suddenly, Bajie laughed and said: 'Brother, you call me foolish, but you're even more foolish! How hard is this? The Master can recite the Tightening Spell, but the demon cannot. Just have them both recite it, and you'll know which is which!'
summary_zh: 孙悟空在金銮殿前发现真假唐僧，一时无法分辨，向八戒和沙僧求助；八戒灵机一动，建议让两人念紧箍咒以辨真伪。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
60 悟空一想，是好主意，便豁出头疼，叫两人念咒。那真唐僧顿时念起来；那魔王怎么晓得，口里只管胡哼乱哼。八戒听出，叫道：‘这乱哼的却是妖怪了。’
61 那魔王露出马脚，纵身跳到云头便走。好八戒，大喝一声，急驾云头赶上。那沙僧不肯落后，丢下师父，也取出宝杖，跟踪助战。
page_text_en:
60 Wukong thought, 'That's a good idea,' and, risking a headache, told the two to chant the spell. The real Tang Monk immediately began chanting; the demon king, not knowing what to do, just mumbled nonsense. Bajie heard it and shouted, 'The one mumbling nonsense is the monster!' 
61 The demon king revealed himself, leaped onto the clouds, and fled. Good Bajie, shouting loudly, quickly mounted the clouds to pursue. Sha Wujing, unwilling to lag behind, left his master and also drew his staff to follow and assist in the battle.
summary_zh: 孙悟空让真假唐僧念咒以辨真伪，假唐僧因不懂咒语而胡乱哼叫，被猪八戒识破；随后魔王现出原形逃走，猪八戒和沙僧立即驾云追赶助战。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
62 两个狠和尚，围住一个泼妖魔，钉钯、宝杖，一齐打上去。悟空看那妖魔左右招架，全无惧色。心想：我老孙跳高些，来个老鹰抓鸡，结果那泼魔吧。
63 悟空纵上九霄，正要落将下来擒住那妖怪，只见东北方向一朵彩云飘然而来，有人大声叫道：‘孙悟空，且慢下手！’
page_text_en:
62 Two fierce monks surrounded a rascally demon, attacking with a rake and a magic staff. Wukong saw the demon parrying left and right, showing no fear. He thought: I’ll jump higher, use the eagle-clutching-chicken move, and finish off that rascal.
63 Wukong soared up to the heavens, about to descend and capture the demon, when suddenly a colorful cloud drifted in from the northeast. A voice shouted loudly: 'Sun Wukong, wait a moment!'
summary_zh: 孙悟空与猪八戒、沙僧合力围攻逃走的魔王，悟空欲用绝招将其制服；此时，东北方飘来一朵彩云，有人高声喊住悟空，让他暂且不要下手。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
64 悟空细看，原来是文殊菩萨到了，赶忙上前施礼道：
“菩萨，哪里去？”文殊道：“我来替你收这妖怪的。”悟空大喜，连连道谢。
65 文殊从袖中取出照妖镜，照住了那怪的原身，悟空招呼八戒、沙僧齐来见了菩萨，三人朝镜里看去，那魔王原来是一只青毛狮子。
page_text_en:
64 Wukong looked closely and saw that it was Bodhisattva Manjushri who had arrived. He hurried forward to bow and said, "Bodhisattva, where are you going?" Manjushri replied, "I have come to capture this demon for you." Wukong was overjoyed and thanked him repeatedly.
65 Manjushri took out the demon-revealing mirror from his sleeve and shone it on the monster's true form. Wukong called for Bajie and Sha Wujing to come and meet the Bodhisattva. The three of them looked into the mirror and saw that the demon king was originally a blue-haired lion.
summary_zh: 孙悟空在追击魔王时，文殊菩萨现身相助。菩萨用照妖镜照出魔王真身，原来是青毛狮子，悟空随即招呼八戒和沙僧一同前来拜见菩萨。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
66 菩萨念个咒，魔王现了原形。菩萨放莲花罩定妖魔，坐在它背上，辞别悟空等三人，仍回五台山去。
67 悟空等回到宫里，把文殊菩萨降魔收怪的事学说了一遍，那国王父子，众大臣听了，个个叩拜谢恩。那国王跪在地上道：“师父救我回生，这个王位让与师父，师父不要推辞。”
page_text_en:
66 The Bodhisattva chanted a spell, and the demon revealed its true form. The Bodhisattva released a lotus to enclose the demon, sat on its back, bid farewell to Wukong and the other two, and returned to Mount Wutai.
67 Wukong and others returned to the palace and recounted the story of Bodhisattva Manjushri subduing the demon. The king, his son, and the ministers, upon hearing it, all knelt to express their gratitude. The king knelt on the ground and said, "Master, you saved my life. I offer you this throne. Please do not refuse."
summary_zh: 文殊菩萨用咒语使魔王现原形，并用莲花罩住它，骑着狮子返回五台山；孙悟空等人回宫后向国王和大臣讲述降魔经过，国王感激涕零，跪地请求唐僧接受王位。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》
title_en: The Journey to the West 14: The Real and Fake Tang Sanzang
source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
68 唐僧哪里肯要，国王又要让给悟空，悟空笑道：“老孙想做皇帝，天下万国，早做遍了。我们只是要去西天拜佛求经，你不用再让，还是做你的国王吧。”
69 国王这才宣旨重新就位。传令宫廷画师，画了唐僧师徒四位图像，供奉在金銮殿上。
page_text_en:
68 Tang Sanzang refused, and the king tried to offer the throne to Wukong again. Wukong laughed, saying, 'I've already been emperor in countless kingdoms. We're only going to the Western Heaven to worship the Buddha and seek scriptures. You don't need to insist—just remain your king.'
69 The king then issued an edict to resume his position. He ordered the court painter to paint portraits of the four disciples of Tang Sanzang, to be enshrined in the Golden Hall.
summary_zh: 唐僧拒绝国王让位，孙悟空表示自己已做遍天下皇帝，只求西天取经；国王随后重新登基，并命画师绘制唐僧师徒画像供奉于金銮殿。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》

source_file: 连环画《西游记14：真假唐僧》（6-10岁）.pdf

70 师徒们不愿耽搁时间，便要辞行。国王取出珍珠财宝，金银绸缎，献与唐僧。唐僧丝毫不受，只是倒换了关文，催徒弟急忙赶路而去。要知后事如何，请看《火云洞》。
